July 17, 2026

Consistent conditions make for a solid day on Wausau-area rivers and streams

Anglers heading out to the Wisconsin River will find flows running at 2,060 cfs with a light northeasterly breeze and steady barometric pressure keeping conditions consistent. Expect daylight from 5:27 a.m. to 8:42 p.m. Fishing conditions this week peak on Saturday, with a high near 83°F and dry skies on area rivers and lakes.
